data.one_liner: Bottom navigation bar with sliding clipping effect and ripple on tap.
data.what_it_does: Provides a bottom navigation bar where the selected item slides with a clipping animation. Supports up to four items and optional per‑item active/inactive colors.
use_when: You need a small (2‑4 items) animated bottom navigation bar with a distinctive sliding clip effect.
You want a ready‑made widget that handles the animation without custom code.
avoid_when: You need more than four navigation items.
You require a fully customizable navigation bar layout or platform‑specific behavior.
strengths: Simple API with optional per‑item colors
weaknesses: Maximum of four items limits complex apps
No built‑in support for deep linking or route management
